resources.string: Ok, I give up. You\'re a clinical case. 💀

string-array.name: insults_phase_1
string-array.item: Want to be insulted? Easy: you\'re still there!
You\'re trading your life for a spreadsheet. What a bargain!
You\'re working for free. Say it out loud: FREE!
Shut it all down or I send your browser history to your boss! 😈

string-array.name: insults_phase_2
string-array.item: Your boss is already home. On the couch. Laughing at you!
When you retire they\'ll get you a cake. From the discount store. Expired!
Your plants are dead. So is your social life. Guess who\'s next?
Your paycheck doesn\'t even know your name.

string-array.name: insults_phase_3
string-array.item: STOP! NOW. THIS IS NOT A SUGGESTION, IT\'S A THREAT!
An app is yelling at you. You\'ve hit rock bottom and you\'re still digging.
Last chance, then I\'m calling your mother. And telling her EVERYTHING!
